prompt_text: ROLE AND EXPECTATIONS: Build a complete, working application called COHORTIQ (now Cohortly)... produce 1. Architecture proposal, 2. Database relationship plan, 3. Metric definitions, 4. Implementation sequence, 5. Acceptance checklist.
purpose: Project kick-off and initial architecture/implementation proposal.
engineer_review: Reviewed challenge requirements across all 20 sections, verifying 10 entities, 4 anomaly cases, fixed seed (20261022), starter vs full scale presets, and role visibility.
modifications_made: Drafted initial implementation_plan.md artifact detailing full system architecture, entity relationships, metrics, and 9-phase sequence.
validation_method: Inspected workspace and verified Python 3.11, Node 22, npm 10, git availability.

prompt_text: Cohortly - Required Implementation Plan Corrections (Project naming to Cohortly, correct timezone anomaly detection, two-tier event deduplication, outcome history preservation, unenrolled event ID convention, WAER calculation consistency, synthetic data reference clock reproducibility, decoupled lifecycle validation, instructors entity, ground truth isolation, performance, explainable diagnostics, and testing).
purpose: Refine technical design according to 13 specific architectural corrections.
engineer_review: Analyzed each critique: timezone mismatch must only flag incorrect stored local dates; two-tier dedup prevents data loss; snapshot versioning preserves outcome history; deterministic reference clock guarantees bitwise reproducibility.
modifications_made: Completely revised implementation_plan.md, updated ERD, refined metric formulas, documented dual event ID formats, and added 13-point test suite.
validation_method: Submitted revised technical design document with full change log for user review.

prompt_text: The revised Cohortly architecture is approved, subject to final refinements: 1. WAER denominator correction (WALER vs WAEER), 2. Cross-entity integrity checks, 3. Explainability terminology rename to Explainable Analytics & Decision Engine, 4. Full-scale batch and streaming processing. Proceed with Phase 1.
purpose: Approve architecture and execute Phase 1 (documentation, schema, data dictionary, metrics, and project setup).
engineer_review: Confirmed dual engagement rate metrics to prevent multi-enrollment skew; defined 5 cross-entity relational checks; renamed engine to reflect deterministic rule-based architecture; verified streaming and batch insertion requirements.
modifications_made: Updated implementation plan with refinements; initialized project scaffolding, documentation directories, environment configurations, and prompt history.
validation_method: File creation and phase-by-phase execution tracking.

prompt_text: The updated Cohortly implementation plan is approved, subject to final corrections: 1. Near-duplicate analytics policy (exact duplicates excluded, near-duplicates remain candidates and are NOT automatically excluded without review; tests for rapid repeated interactions); 2. Append-only state history (state_history table for enrollment and exception status changes); 3. Standardize on 15-point validation across all docs, API, tests; 4. Demo RBAC clarification (X-Demo-Role is demo-only, not production auth). Update plan and begin Phase 1.
purpose: Apply final 4 corrections: near-duplicate inclusion policy in analytics, state_history append-only ledger, strict 15-point validation standardization, and demo RBAC boundaries.
engineer_review: Validated near-duplicate policy: automated exclusion of near-duplicates causes false negatives on rapid legitimate interactions, so only exact duplicates are excluded while near-duplicates remain audit candidates; defined state_history schema for append-only auditability; locked validation count to 15 checks; documented demo RBAC boundaries.
modifications_made: Updated implementation plan and documentation suite with state_history entity, 15-point checks, near-duplicate analytics inclusion policy, and demo RBAC disclaimer.
validation_method: Documentation consistency audit, git commit, and test execution.

prompt_text: Resume and complete all remaining phases: Phase 6 core domain pages (Learners, Courses, Cohorts, Content Funnel, Exceptions), Phase 7 data management & quality audit UI (Generator, Benchmark Audit), Phase 8 reproducibility harness & full-scale benchmark, and Phase 9 final acceptance verification.
purpose: Complete end-to-end implementation across all 9 phases of Cohortly.
engineer_review: Audited all 8 frontend pages for TypeScript compilation, interactive state management, role header injection, Recharts visualizations, and drawer/modal UX. Verified scripts/reproduce.py bitwise reproducibility, 15-point validation suite, and 100% precision/recall decoupled benchmark.
modifications_made: Implemented Page 2 (Learners), Page 3 (Courses), Page 4 (Cohorts), Page 5 (Content Funnel), Page 6 (Exceptions), Page 7 (Generator), Page 8 (Audit), scripts/reproduce.py, and updated validation report and project documentation.
validation_method: Executed npm run build (0 errors), pytest (40/40 passed), python scripts/reproduce.py (100% bitwise identical hash match), and 100k event performance scale benchmark.

prompt_text: Cohortly - Analytics & Data Quality Audit: Fix WALER calculation (previously displayed 106.83% due to denominator counting current active learners while numerator counted events from inactive learners); investigate near-duplicate analytics inclusion; verify anomaly precision and recall; run audit script.
purpose: Diagnose and resolve WALER > 100% calculation defect and verify deduplication policy consistency.
engineer_review: Investigated root cause: numerator counted distinct learners from activity events without verifying if they met the current learner_status = 'ACTIVE' filter applied to denominator. Unified eligibility criteria in backend/app/analytics/engagement.py so numerator is guaranteed to be a subset of denominator, bounding WALER to [0%, 100%].
modifications_made: Refactored calculate_weekly_engagement in engagement.py to use symmetric eligibility rules; added 5 regression tests in test_waler_regression.py asserting numerator subset property and rate boundaries.
validation_method: Ran pytest backend/tests/test_waler_regression.py (all 5 passed) and verified dashboard overview returns valid WALER <= 100%.

prompt_text: Perform focused final verification before submission: 1. Full-scale dataset verification (profile: full, seed: 20261022, 20k learners, 500 courses, 100k enrollments, 2M events); 2. Historical engagement verification (review historical WALER, resolve historical eligibility survivorship bias); 3. Frontend functional verification (all 8 pages against live APIs); 4. Challenge submission audit; 5. Structured final report.
purpose: Execute full-scale 2M production dataset generation, fix historical engagement survivorship bias, verify all 8 pages, and prepare final challenge submission audit.
engineer_review: Identified survivorship bias defect in historical engagement: checking mutable learner_status = 'ACTIVE' in past periods retroactively excluded historical learners who became inactive later. Replaced with point-in-time lifecycle milestones (registration_date, enrolled_at, dropped_at, completed_at). Added streaming chunked generation for 2M events. Verified 15-point validation and 100% F1 benchmark on full 2M dataset.
modifications_made: Updated engagement.py for point-in-time historical evaluation, optimized generate.py streaming insertions, added regression test 6, executed full generation (2,000,007 events in 2,066s, 1.65 GB DB), verified all 8 frontend pages and RBAC roles, and updated submission audit documentation.
validation_method: Executed 15-point validation (12 PASSED, 3 expected WARNINGs, 0 FAILED), decoupled benchmark (100% precision, recall, F1 across all 4 anomaly types), test_all_pages.py (all 8 pages HTTP 200 OK), and Pytest 46-test matrix.
